place.source_title: Glass pavilion in Polk Bros Park at the foot of Navy Pier (2016)

brief: A 2016 shade and café pavilion: a low flat-roofed glass box with a thin white canopy roof on slim columns, set on a lawn of the pier-foot park. One photo. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

floors: G G G G G G
facade.notes: a glass café/shade pavilion in Polk Bros Park at the foot of Navy Pier (2016): a long low all-glass box under a thin white overhanging roof plate on slim columns; a lawn, paths, tall light masts

why.note: 2010s park pavilions: glass boxes that hide nothing, so the park stays open and watched
